title: Design and self-assembly of new [2 × 2] grids constructed by lanthanide ions and a Schiff base

synthesis.procedure: Main text: equimolar LnCl3·6H2O, H2L and ethylenediamine (1:1 metal:ligand) in a one-step self-assembly; experimental quantities are given in the SI. SI: 0.5 mmol (0.1176 g) H2L and 0.5 mmol SmCl3·6H2O (0.1824 g) were dissolved in 10 mL DMF and heated until boiling and the solids dissolved. Ethylenediamine (transcribed in the SI as “33 L”, 0.5 mmol; the stated amount is consistent with 33 μL) was added, boiling was maintained for 10–15 min, and the yellow solution was cooled to room temperature and filtered. Yellow crystals were obtained by diffusion of isopropyl alcohol into the mother liquor at room temperature; needle-shaped crystals of 1 were suitable for single-crystal XRD.
